source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new 2072 xpcshell test changes the SQLite root name to server1, asserts the created local account key and adds matching child folders before opening a per-folder DB. It checks scalar header fields, deep key arrays, flag persistence, forward/reverse enumerators and markAllRead’s changed-key result. This validates intended compatibility surfaces, not every legacy database method. Fixed tests also check cross-folder header rejection and folder identity. Keep account/fixture IDs aligned and check the actual caller/API version: current LiveView takes numeric folder IDs, replacing the old null-folder-object guards. Historical missing assertion messages are not defects by themselves. No test run occurred.
title: Panorama compatibility tests bind real folder identity to fixture data
